lines.text: Ten linen curtains with cherubim worked into them are to be joined together with fifty gold clasps.
Over the tabernacle goes a tent of eleven goat hair curtains, covered with ram skins dyed red and fine leather.
A veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn hangs on gold hooks, and the ark of the Testimony goes behind.
God tells Moses to build a square altar of acacia wood overlaid with silver, with poles to carry it.
Moses and his sons are to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening until morning.
